# Route Mobile (ROUTE) – Research Brief

## Recent Financial Performance (Q4 FY26)
- For the quarter ended **March 31, 2026**, Route Mobile reported **consolidated revenue from operations of ₹1,130.90 crores** and **net profit attributable to owners of the parent of ₹109.32 crores** (audited, filed May 7, 2026) [1].
- Full‑year FY26 consolidated figures are **not available** in this data run; only Q4 data was provided. [1]

## Dividend & Corporate Actions
- A **third interim dividend of ₹3 per share** was declared for FY26, with record date **February 12, 2026** and ex‑date **February 13, 2026** [9][10][11][12].
- No buyback was announced during FY26 based on exchange filings (only a buyback from July 2022 appears on SEBI’s site) [6].

## Current Market Data (as of June 10, 2026)
- **NSE price:** ₹518.35 (−2.76%) [14]
- **Market cap:** ₹3,213 crores (approx.) [15]
- **P/E (trailing):** 13.44 [15]
- **Forward P/E:** 8.27 [15]
- **Price‑to‑book:** 1.16 [15]
- **Dividend yield:** 2.32% (trailing) [15]
- **EPS (TTM):** ₹37.94 [15]
- **52‑week high/low:** ₹1,158.00 / ₹410.70 [15]

## Key Open Questions (not answered in provided sources)
- What drove Q4 FY26 revenue and net profit? (No earnings call transcript or investor presentation details were included.)
- What were full‑year FY26 consolidated revenue and net profit? (Q1, Q2, Q3 results are absent.)
- What is the promoter holding percentage as of March 2026? (Shareholding pattern not found in filings.)
- What was the impact of the reported Q3 write‑off (₹136 crore) on Q4 or full‑year results? [10]

*Sources used: [1] Q4 results filing; [6] SEBI buyback record; [9][10][11][12] dividend history; [14] NSE price snapshot; [15] Yahoo Finance fundamentals.*
